Name: Custom Prize Ticket
Author: vroldo
Description:
I made this mod because I got bored of Lewis' rewards never being updated and also I don't want those not so fancy trees and pig painting.
This mod lets you fully replace the prize ticket reward pool.
[list]
[*]Since there are so many items in the game, i made an in game item search.
[*]Simple UI to edit the reward list (Require [b]Generic Mod Config Menu[/b])
[*]Live reward list, changes will instantly applied to prize machine.
[*]3 items minimum, since below that will break the reward code.
[/list] 
[b]Requirements[/b]
[list]
[*]Stardew Valley 1.6+
[*]SMAPI 4.0.0+
[*]Generic Mod Config Menu 1.16.0+
[/list] 
[b]How to Install
[/b]Copy CustomPrizeTicket folder to "Stardew Valley/Mods/"

[b]How to Use[/b]
  1. Launch the game through SMAPI
  2. Open the pause menu → Options → Mod Config → Custom Prize Ticket
  3. Use the Enable Reward Replacement checkbox to toggle the mod on or off
  4. Under Add Reward, type in the search box to find an item, click it to select it, then click + Add to List
  5. Under Current Rewards, review your list and remove entries as needed (minimum 3 required)
  6. Click Save, changes take effect the next time you open the prize machine

If the mod is disabled or removed, the vanilla prize list is restored automatically.

[b]Known Issue
[/b]It seems that if there are only a few items in the custom list, the game will also add the default rewards to the pool.

[b]Future Updates[/b][list]
[*]For multiplayer, the host has a toggle to sync their reward list globally for all players.
[/list]
[b]Is it working on multiplayer?
[/b]Yes, from version 0.1.2 and above.
Each farmer can have a different reward list.
